ko.executive_summary: GlobalFoundries is expanding photonics capacity to serve growing Chinese data center demand. The optical transceiver and VCSEL markets are projected to grow strongly through 2035, driven by data center infrastructure buildout.
key_facts: GlobalFoundries targeting Chinese data center photonics demand
VCSEL market projected to reach US$14.74 billion by 2035
Optical transceiver market growth forecast through 2035

implications.text: GlobalFoundries' photonics bet signals competitive effort to capture share in Chinese data center CPO/transceiver supply chains, likely targeting 400G/800G and beyond.
VCSEL's 18.2% CAGR reflects sustained demand from data center interconnect and emerging applications; transceiver market growth tied to hyperscaler capex cycles and AI infrastructure expansion.
Explicit focus on China indicates recognition of data center gravity shifting to APAC, with on-shore photonics capacity a strategic imperative.

ko.counterpoint: Headlines lack specifics on product roadmap, timeline, or competitive positioning vs. established transceiver vendors (Broadcom, Marvell, Cisco); market projections are directional and subject to hyperscaler capex volatility.
